item.title: Texas Tech raises Special Olympics Unified banner
item.description: Texas Tech University's University Recreation held a banner raising ceremony Tuesday to signify its status as Special Olympics Unified banner bearer school.

item.title: The story of Danny Hardaway, Texas Tech's first Black athlete
item.description: In honor of Black History Month, EverythingLubbock.com is recognizing figures and groups from around the Lubbock area that helped pave the way for African Americans to have representation in the community. This includes the first African American athlete to play for Texas Tech, Danny Hardaway.

item.title: Texas Anti-Gang Center has grand opening in Lubbock
item.description: The Texas Anti-Gang Center of Lubbock had its official ribbon-cutting ceremony on February 17, with remarks from Sheriff Kelly Rowe, former police chief Greg Stevens, and County Judge Curtis Parrish, and was funded by a grant from the Governor's Criminal Justice Division and land donated by Lubbock County commissioners.

item.title: Plainview native builds performance horse business from the ground up
item.description: In the wide-open plains of West Texas, where agriculture runs deep and hard work is a way of life, Trip Fortenberry is carving out a name for himself in the world of performance horses.

item.title: Remembering the man behind Mama Josies restaurant
item.description: Frank Castaneda Sr. built a successful restaurant in Lubbock, Texas, through hard work and dedication, creating a legacy that continues to be carried on by his son Javier.

item.title: Crews respond to fires in Lubbock area amid high winds and blowing dust
item.description: Grass fires have been reported in the Lubbock area due to high winds and blowing dust, with a Red Flag Warning in place through 7 p.m. Wednesday.

item.title: Early voting locations for Lubbock County March 2026 election
item.description: Early voting for the March primaries in Lubbock County, Texas begins on February 17, 2026, with 22 locations available for voters to cast their ballot.
